paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: The plot displays training loss curves for the post-training setting, illustrating how the loss decreases over iterations for different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from approximately 95,000 to 125,000 and is scaled linearly with major tick marks at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 and is also scaled linearly, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Four distinct lines are shown: a pink solid line representing "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)," a blue solid line for "SepLLM (n=128)," an orange solid line for "SepLLM (n=64)," and a red dashed line for "Vanilla before post-training." All four lines start at a loss of approximately 3.0 at the beginning of the iteration range and exhibit a steep initial decline. The pink line decreases rapidly, reaching a loss of about 2.2 by the end of the range. The blue and orange lines follow a similar trajectory, with the blue line slightly above the orange line, both ending at a loss of approximately 2.3. The red dashed line remains relatively flat, hovering around a loss of 2.35 throughout the entire iteration range.
